quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026, semi-annual report): net sales JPY 173,728 million (+9.9% year on year), operating profit JPY 15,102 million (+10.5%), ordinary profit JPY 14,845 million (+9.3%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 7,235 million (-14.0%). By segment (net sales / operating profit): Carbon Black JPY 83,480 million (+10.5%) / JPY 7,239 million (-11.1%); Fine Carbon JPY 33,016 million (+19.1%) / JPY 4,716 million (+6.9%); Smelting & Lining JPY 30,649 million (+12.9%) / JPY 2,020 million (+563.9%); Graphite Electrodes JPY 16,878 million (-8.5%) / JPY 792 million (+60.3%); Industrial Furnaces and Related Products JPY 5,409 million (+28.7%) / JPY 1,213 million (+37.0%); Other JPY 4,293 million (-13.8%) / JPY 64 million (-77.6%). R&D expenses JPY 2,258 million. In May 2026 the company announced an upward revision of its FY2026 consolidated forecast.

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fine Carbon, H1 FY2026 (management's analysis): weak demand in the SiC power-semiconductor market continued, but sales volume of its main product, solid SiC focus rings for the memory-semiconductor market, rose significantly, so segment net sales and operating profit both increased year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: Fine Carbon net sales JPY 33,016 million (+19.1%); operating profit JPY 4,716 million (+6.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokai Carbon Co. semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, H1 FY2026 (management's analysis): Carbon Black - lower volumes from tire makers' production adjustments were covered by new customers and spot sales, and the Thai site consolidated from H2 2025 contributed; operating profit fell on higher depreciation as the new Thai plant started operating and on worse margins from higher feedstock-oil prices caused by the Middle East situation; the new Thai plant, with state-of-the-art flue-gas desulfurisation and denitrification equipment, was completed and the relocation project continues. Smelting & Lining - despite some transport disruption from the Middle East situation, cost cuts and licence income for its next-generation low-environmental-impact cathode RuC (Ready-to-use Cathode) supported earnings. Graphite Electrodes - global crude steel output was weak, but electric-arc-furnace steel output in the US, its main market, was firm and Japan dipped only slightly; sales fell after the deconsolidation of TOKAI ERFTCARBON GmbH but restructuring lifted operating profit. Industrial Furnaces and Related Products - LiB capex in the energy sector stayed stagnant, but demand for multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC), mainly for AI data centers, increased, and sales of resistors used in power infrastructure were strong as transmission and distribution grids are built out worldwide. Friction materials grew 3.4% on two-wheeler, industrial-machinery, construction-machinery and agricultural-machinery demand, while mining demand was weak with lower Indonesian coal output.
quarterly_data.figure: Industrial Furnaces net sales JPY 5,409 million (+28.7%); operating profit JPY 1,213 million (+37.0%)
